_comment: All GPIO numbers use BCM (Broadcom) numbering. See docs/hardware-setup.md for the wiring diagram.

fire._comment: Primary fire / jump / action. Maps to RetroPad A button.

action2._comment: Secondary action (barrel roll in 1942, etc). Maps to RetroPad B button.

coin_start._comment: Sends coin insert (BTN_SELECT) then Player 1 Start (BTN_START) automatically.
